label: v1.1 Initial release
resolver_behavior: Linear range lookup across serial_ranges in stihl_database.json. Supports chainsaws, blowers, and brushcutters.
fallback_behavior: If no range matched, estimateYearBySerial gave broad decade estimate per plant code.
default_model_behavior: Fallback model string was 'STIHL Benzine / Accu Machine' (no specific model forced).
notable_regression: None (initial diverse baseline, but broad ranges were partly estimated).

label: Suffix guide & letter decoder enrichment
notable_regression: First data loss: 9 of 13 historical ranges removed from stihl_database.json (041 AV, 026/MS 260 Vroeg, MS 260 Laat, MS 500i, MS 290, BR 340/420, FS 130, FS 120).

label: Engine v2.0 with SQLite & seed scripts
resolver_behavior: serial_breakpoints table introduced in SQLite and stihl_database.json.
fallback_behavior: serialStr.substring(0, 4) series_code heuristic introduced in decoder.js.
default_model_behavior: If series_code matched a model, assigned model_name without range verification.
notable_regression: series_code substring(0,4) heuristic conflated part family with machine serial numbers.

label: Implement Serial Breakpoints Engine
resolver_behavior: Introduced StihlRangeResolver and model_serial_ranges table. First-match array resolution.
fallback_behavior: Hardcoded default in decoder.js: '|| database.models.find(m => m.id === \'stihl_ms_261_cm\') || database.models[0]'.
default_model_behavior: MASS DEFAULT: 100% of unmapped serials blindly resolved to MS 261 C-M! All plants defaulted to Waiblingen Germany.
notable_regression: Critical double regression: (1) Synthesized 25M range 145000000–169999999 for MS 260, merging BR 340/420 and MS 260 Laat. (2) Mass default to MS 261 C-M.

label: Phased SEO Engine & pilot model pages
resolver_behavior: model_serial_ranges pruned to match pilot SEO model pages (MS 260, MS 261). MS 201 dropped.
fallback_behavior: Retained mass fallback to MS 261 C-M.
notable_regression: Further range data loss: MS 201 ranges deleted, leaving only 3 ranges in canonical database.

label: FIX: Restored full serial number breakpoint resolution
resolver_behavior: Attempted to fix unresolved serials by adding hardcoded prefix matching in decoder.js: 18/17 -> MS 261, 14/15/16 -> MS 260.
fallback_behavior: Fallback model set to 'MS 261 C-M Gen 2', fallback category 'Kettingzaag'.
default_model_behavior: Every 14/15/16 serial became MS 260. Every 17/18 serial became MS 261. All other serials defaulted to MS 261 C-M Gen 2.
notable_regression: Mass fallback heuristic: 95% of all test serials forced to MS 260 or MS 261.

label: FASE 34 SEO integrity hardening & zero fallbacks
resolver_behavior: Removed hardcoded startsWith prefix logic and MS 261 C-M Gen 2 default from decoder.js.
fallback_behavior: Returned 'Onbekend Model' when rangeMatch was null.
default_model_behavior: No default model string in decoder.js.
notable_regression: Left the synthetic 25M range 145000000–169999999 for MS 260 in stihl_database.json, leaving 145M-169.9M mapped to MS 260.

label: Phase 35C.4.3.2.2.3 block unevidenced breakpoint technical claims
resolver_behavior: StihlRangeResolver filtered matches; technical claims blocked from breakpoint records.
fallback_behavior: Fail-closed on technical specs when identity is not exact.
notable_regression: Range dataset remained frozen at 3 Plant 1 ranges; 145M-169.9M still mapped to MS 260.

label: Phase 36 serial resolution, model assist and MS 170 evidence
resolver_behavior: Added SerialChronologyResolver and modelAssist. Staged MS 170 evidence gate.
fallback_behavior: Exact model null, probable series surfaced when range matched.
default_model_behavior: Zero default model, but 3 ranges remained authority.
notable_regression: Frozen at 3 ranges. Range audit Phase 36 officially recorded total_ranges = 3.

label: Current Production Baseline (Phase 45D)
resolver_behavior: Identical to Phase 36. Resolves 145M-169.9M to MS 260 (Klassiek / Analoog), 171M-199.9M to MS 261.
fallback_behavior: Zero default model, but 100% of other plants return MODEL_NOT_IDENTIFIED.
default_model_behavior: No model literal fallback in decoder.js, but 25M range in stihl_database.json acts as mass MS 260 attractor for Plant 1.
notable_regression: Residual defect: 25M MS 260 range, absence of Plant 2/3/8 ranges, client UI state residue.
